Jet black hair, short and jaggedly cropped. Glowing crimson eyes with a sharp, piercing expression. Appears in the mid-twenties with a stern, hardened maturity. Lean, athletic build. Wears a slate grey armored tunic with obsidian plating and a tattered dark cloak. Features a metallic grey mask covering the lower half of the face.
BODY COLOR: ash grey
